from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollment(BaseModel):
    """Enrollment data for a single university extracted from a Common Data Set report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    total_undergraduates: int | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate population count")
    hispanic_latino_count: int | None = Field(description="Count of Hispanic/Latino undergraduates")
    black_non_hispanic_count: int | None = Field(description="Count of Black or African American, non-Hispanic undergraduates")
    non_resident_alien_count: int | None = Field(description="Count of non-resident alien undergraduates")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityEnrollment]
